exempt.FirewallMain: the core-firewall executable's entry point: `session` is Core.Firewall.Loop.main, every other command Core.Protocol.main of Core.Firewall.protocol, audited under Firewall and CoreProtocol
exempt.FirewallDifftest: the core-firewall-difftest executable's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve over Core.Firewall.opFn and outerFn, audited under Firewall and Difftest
exempt.FirewallHonestDifftestMain: the firewall-honest-difftest server's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve of FirewallHonestDifftest.table, which verity/protocols/flock/prover/tests/test_honest_reqs.py drives against rec_live's requests; audited under FirewallHonestDifftest

escapes.Core.Firewall.pyJson: partial def: Python's json.dumps(sort_keys=True) of any JSON value, recursing through it, for the values an open's error message quotes; no proof is about it, and the agreement tests (tests/test_firewall_release_agreement.py) cover it

Firewall.why: the release side is code: Lean core and its Std (the wall clock), C-Flock's verifier library (its canonical JSON, SHA-512, the firewall's contract and its session loop) and the core protocol interface, no Mathlib and nothing of Security (the layout rule: Lean code never requires Security)

FirewallHonestDifftest.why: the honest worker's requests' port reads C-Flock's Flock.Firewall.honestReqs and what the firewall's load check takes, through the harness
